description: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

taps.phrase: to raise a cloud of dust
